title: Among cards illustrated by Allen Williams that are legal in the 'commander'
question: Among cards illustrated by Allen Williams that are legal in the 'commander' format, identify those with the highest converted mana cost. For each such card, return its name, frame version, and whether it is banned in any format.

prediction.sql:
WITH commander_legal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.XCL_049 AS name,
        c.XCL_019 AS frame_version,
        c.XCL_011 AS cmc,
        c.XCL_072 AS uuid
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Allen Williams'
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
),
max_cmc AS (
    SELECT MAX(cmc) AS m FROM commander_legal
)
SELECT
    clc.name,
    clc.frame_version,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM legalities l2
        WHERE l2.XCL_086 = clc.uuid
          AND l2.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
    ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_banned
FROM commander_legal clc
INNER JOIN max_cmc mc ON clc.cmc = mc.m

        c.XCL_049 AS name,
        c.XCL_019 AS frame_version,
        c.XCL_011 AS cmc,
        c.XCL_072 AS uuid
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Allen Williams'
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
),
max_cmc AS (
    SELECT MAX(cmc) AS m FROM commander_legal
)
SELECT
    clc.name,
    clc.frame_version,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM legalities l2
        WHERE l2.XCL_086 = clc.uuid
          AND l2.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
    ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_banned
FROM commander_legal clc
INNER JOIN max_cmc mc ON clc.cmc = mc.m
